description: This file defines a composable UI component for displaying a list of chat messages in an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It manages different chat states such as streaming assistant text, pending tool calls, typing indicators, and empty chat hints, rendering appropriate UI bubbles for each state.

classes.name: EmptyChatHint
classes.description: A composable function that displays a hint message when there are no chat messages, pending actions, or streaming text.

methods.name: ChatMessageListCard
methods.description: Main composable that displays the list of chat messages, streaming text, pending tool calls, and typing indicator with appropriate layout and effects.

methods.name: EmptyChatHint
methods.description: Displays a prompt encouraging the user to start the chat or connect the gateway depending on system state.
